svg.title: Old Bridge Road — Three-arch old bridge
svg.desc: Two abutment towers and an old bridge deck divide the river crossing. Climb the repair scaffold or stay on the wide public deck; props shelter each landing. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Two abutment towers and an old bridge deck divide the river crossing. Climb the repair
scaffold or stay on the wide public deck; props shelter each landing.
7 raised landings · 2 stair flights · 3 rope climbs · 2 ladders · 20 placed props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
P1 Applefall Orchard · P2 Hillkeep Outskirts · P3 Bandersnout Ford
Encounter: Hedge Nibbler · Common; repeatable solo combat AND equivalent aid/repair objective.
